monitors.name: KR policy and regulatory monitor
monitors.goal: Alert when Korean financial, industrial, trade, competition, or disclosure policy pages add or change items that may affect portfolio risk, sector exposure, market liquidity, AI infrastructure, semiconductors, batteries, energy, biotechnology, platform regulation, or National Pension Service rebalancing.

monitors.name: US SEC and regulatory monitor
monitors.goal: Alert when US SEC or market-regulatory pages add or change items relevant to listed portfolio companies, AI data infrastructure, biotech disclosure risk, EV charging, plant-based food, China education ADRs, or market structure.

monitors.name: Portfolio company IR monitor
monitors.goal: Alert when a portfolio company investor relations page publishes a new press release, earnings release, shareholder letter, presentation, filing pointer, financing update, product milestone, guidance change, or risk disclosure.

monitors.name: Breaking investment theme monitor
monitors.goal: Alert when a new web result appears that is materially relevant to AI semiconductors, HBM, power equipment, battery supply chains, biotechnology AI drug discovery, National Pension Service domestic equity rebalancing, US market structure, or a current portfolio company.
